decisions.reason: Premium support fits the firm's agency-focused 24/7 service promise, uses existing service operations, and likely meets the aspiration through recurring revenue, while the growing, hiring firm has slack to carry it.

The version manager builds on the established platform, was promoted as a current highlight in 2019, and reduces recurring operational work for agencies, so it is unlikely to trigger problemistic search.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the core business and was likely a GDPR-era add-on with uncertain payoff, but it costs little to maintain and supports customer compliance, so a firm with slack would probably keep it for now despite a real risk of pruning.
Scalable agency hosting is central to the firm's strategy, was featured on the home page, and sits in a growing hosting market, so its results likely meet the aspiration.
